articles.headline: Tayodin Turns Victorious Secrets Into A Hostage Situation
articles.deck: 63.04 points. Not a typo. Not a bye week. A real live lineup that Tayodin actually submitted.
body: Let's set the scene. DFWGilly rolls into Week 1 with Romo911 and drops 153.92 points on the board like he's got something to prove, which he does not, because the man he's playing is Tayodin, and Tayodin brought a knife to a gun show where the gun show also brought grenades.

Victorious Secrets finished with 63.04 points. That number is going to live in Tayodin's head rent free for the rest of the season, popping up at red lights, at the dinner table, right as he's about to fall asleep, just whispering itself back into existence. A margin of 90.88 points is not a loss, it's a crime scene. DFWGilly didn't even need his whole roster to have a big week, he just needed Tayodin to show up wearing a blindfold and swinging at a pinata that turned out to be a wasp nest.

Nobody else on the Victorious Secrets roster cracked the top performer list. Not one name. Caleb Williams went off for SexRobot69, Josh Allen went off for bearcat2789, Jalen Coker and Jahmyr Gibbs both showed out for LoRdAcE1848, and Tayodin's guys apparently spent Sunday doing anything but playing football. Standings don't lie either, dead last, 0 and 1, and the projection machine already has him pegged at 17.9 percent to make the playoffs with a tag that reads flat out In Trouble, which honestly feels generous after a showing like this.

The rest of the league got to watch a one point classic between Bheinzeyo and bearcat2789 and a legit shootout between tripnistico and BedBathNBIJAN22, and then there's Tayodin's box score sitting in the corner like it got left out of the group chat on purpose. This is the inaugural Shart of the Week, and Tayodin didn't just qualify, he lapped the field going the wrong direction. First one's always special. Frame this one, Tayodin. Or don't, because looking at it again might actually kill you.

So here it is, the whole disgusting ceremony. Grab the pitcher, no wait, grab every pitcher in the building, line them up, and work your way down the row like you're trying to apologize to each one individually for what Victorious Secrets did on Sunday. Chug, bitch.

articles.headline: The Hardware: Week 1 Trophy Ceremony Of Shame And Glory
articles.deck: Seven awards, zero dignity, one guy still owes a chug
body: Gather round, degenerates, it is time to hand out the tin. Nobody gets a stage, nobody gets applause, you get a paragraph and you get on with your miserable week. Let's ruin some nights.

MANAGER OF THE WEEK goes to Jackson of Ha Ha Ha, Now Heres A Guy, who dropped 169.86 points on the league like he was settling a personal beef with every other roster. Nobody else was close. Wear the crown, Jackson, it comes off next Sunday.

THE SHART. Taylor of Victorious Secrets put up 63.04 points and owes a chug, per house rules, no appeals. We covered the gory details elsewhere in this paper so we will not linger here, but Taylor, buddy, drink up.
BLOWOUT goes to Jackson again, because apparently one trophy per week is for cowards. He won by 92.40, which is not a fantasy football score differential so much as a restraining order.

SQUEAKER belongs to Ben of Jackson Off, who won by 1.00 exact point over Bearcat's Hog tied and deep fried squad. One point. Ben should frame the box score and Bearcat should frame nothing, ever, about this game.

LUCKY DOG is Josef of Zyn-bo Squisher, who somehow banked a win with only 116.22 points. That is the fantasy equivalent of parallel parking on the first try after three beers. Don't ask how, just take the trophy and walk away quietly.

HEARTBREAKER goes to Andrew of Bibi's Ballers 69, who scored 146.86 points and still lost. That is a gut punch dressed up as a box score. Jalen Coker and Jahmyr Gibbs both went off for him and it still was not enough, which tells you everything about how stacked this week actually was.

BENCH ROT is Bearcat's, and yes, he is getting a second mention this week for reasons that have nothing to do with the coin flip loss. He left 40.60 points sitting on his bench while losing by exactly 1.00. Bearcat, that is not bad luck, that is a filing error, and somewhere Josh Allen's 35.66 points are laughing at your lineup card.
That's the whole ceremony. Go nurse your grudges, set your lineups better than Bearcat did, and we will do this all again next week.

articles.headline: Nunnells Drops 169.86 On A Corpse
articles.deck: The week's biggest number came with the week's easiest matchup attached to it
body: Let's give credit where it's due. Nunnells put up 169.86 points in Week 1, the best score in the entire Squirtnite FFL, and that's not nothing. That's a full team rolling, top to bottom, no dead spots in the lineup, the kind of week you screenshot and post in the group chat just to watch everyone go quiet for a second.

Except the group chat should probably ask who was on the other side of that scoreboard first. Burrowed Alive, managed by sebeatty, mustered 77.46 points, which turned what could have been a competitive statement win into a 92.4 point beatdown that looked less like fantasy football and more like a hostage situation. Nunnells didn't have to be great. Nunnells just had to show up, and sebeatty's lineup evidently did not.

Worth noting too that nobody on the nunnells roster cracked the league's top performers list this week. No Caleb Williams throwing for 37.26, no Derrick Henry running for 35.3, nothing flashy at all. Just a boring, businesslike, everybody-chips-in win against a team that had already tapped out before kickoff. That's still a 1-0 record and the top spot in the standings, so take the trophy, nunnells. Just know the receipts say you beat a guy who forgot to set his lineup, not the league.

articles.headline: One Point Separates Jackson Off From The Deep Fryer
articles.deck: Bheinzeyo escapes bearcat2789 by a single point despite Josh Allen going off, because fantasy football does not care about your quarterback's feelings.
body: Final score: 123.96 to 122.96. Say that number out loud a few times and let it ruin your week the way it ruined bearcat2789's.

Hog tied and deep fried had every reason to feel good walking into Sunday. Josh Allen threw for 35.66 points wearing the bearcat2789 crest, the kind of quarterback week that usually wins you the whole matchup by itself. Instead it won him nothing. Bheinzeyo's Jackson Off squad matched him stride for stride and then found one extra point somewhere in the couch cushions to close it out 123.96 to 122.96, a margin so thin you could floss with it.

This is the cruelty of Week 1. You can get a monster quarterback performance, you can do everything a fantasy manager is supposed to do, and you still end up 0-1 in the standings because somebody else's flex guy had a better Sunday afternoon by the width of a single point. Bearcat2789 will replay this one in his head all week wondering where that last point went. A different flex decision. A kicker who misses an extra point instead of hitting it. Anything, and this recap has a different headline.

Bheinzeyo does not care about any of that. Jackson Off takes the win, takes the 1-0, and moves on with 123.96 points for and a story he will tell for the rest of the season every time bearcat2789 brings up bad beats. That is how margins like this work. Nobody remembers the effort. Everybody remembers the number.

articles.headline: Around The League: Blowouts, A Shart, And Nunnells Showing Off
articles.deck: Six more games happened while everyone was busy watching a one point classic. Some of these ended before halftime.
body: Let's blow through the carnage while the Jackson Off game of the week soaks up all the attention it doesn't deserve.
Chase Browns with Downs took care of business against ItsYaBoyJack, 118 to 95.2. JPellett3 didn't need style points, just needed ItsYaBoyJack to keep being ItsYaBoyJack.
Romo911's DFWGilly turned Victorious Secrets into an actual crime scene, 153.92 to 63.04. Tayodin's 63.04 wasn't just a loss, it was this week's Shart, and it wasn't close.
Nunnells went nuclear on Burrowed Alive, 169.86 to 77.46. That's the highest score in the league this week and sebeatty had zero answer for it. Manager of the Week, no debate, no committee needed.
50 Shades of Zay held off BedBathNBIJAN22, 162.8 to 142.9, with Kenneth Walker going for 34.1 and doing most of the heavy lifting for tripnistico.

First Down Syndrome survived Bibi's Ballers 69, 156.06 to 146.86, in the closest thing this recap has to a fistfight. LoRdAcE1848 got 33.8 out of Jalen Coker and 33.6 out of Jahmyr Gibbs and still lost, because SexRobot69 was sitting on Caleb Williams dropping 37.26 and Derrick Henry adding 35.3 on top of it. Sometimes you bring a knife and the other guy brought two howitzers.
Zyn-bo Squisher steamrolled The Bhayshul Olympics, 116.22 to 75.3. Mattmcneese's season opener went about as well as the team name suggests these things usually go.

So that's Week 1. Seven winners feeling great about themselves, seven losers already refreshing the waiver wire. See you in the standings, where nunnells is sitting at the top looking real comfortable.

articles.headline: Week 1 Waiver Wire: Unproven Names, Real Numbers
articles.deck: Nobody knows who actually got picked up off waivers this week, but plenty of dudes had performances that scream do not cut me.
body: Look, the packet does not tell me who dropped who for who, so I cannot sit here and pretend I watched fourteen men frantically refresh their app at 4am Wednesday. What I can tell you is which names showed up on scoreboards like they had something to prove, and if any of these guys were sitting on your bench because you did not trust them, congratulations on the free education.

LoRdAcE1848 got a two piece from his own roster, Jalen Coker dropping 33.8 and Jahmyr Gibbs adding 33.6, and somehow still lost to SexRobot69 by 9.2. That is not a waiver wire story, that is a cautionary tale about depth not mattering when your opponent has Caleb Williams throwing for 37.26 and Derrick Henry running for 35.3 on the same roster. Absolutely disgusting stat line for one team.

tripnistico rode Kenneth Walker's 34.1 to a win over BedBathNBIJAN22, margin of 19.9, and now sits at 1-0 with 162.8 points for. If Walker was a speculative add, tripnistico deserves a parade. If he was rostered day one, tripnistico deserves nothing, we take our credit seriously here.
bearcat2789 got 35.66 out of Josh Allen and still found a way to lose by exactly 1 point. Some performances pay off. Some just make the loss hurt more.

articles.headline: Six Men Had Insane Weeks, One of Them Rostered Two of Them
articles.deck: Caleb Williams and Derrick Henry teamed up on SexRobot69's roster like a two man wrecking crew, while LoRdAcE1848 got a stat sheet full of gold and still lost the game
body: Let's start with the guy who somehow went 1-0 in the standings but 2-0 in Big Performances. SexRobot69 rode Caleb Williams to 37.26 points and Derrick Henry to 35.3, which is the kind of week where you check your lineup twice because it feels like a misprint. First Down Syndrome scored 156.06 as a team and somehow that was the SECOND most impressive thing SexRobot69 did this week, right behind having Caleb Williams and Derrick Henry both go off in the same three hour window.

Josh Allen dropped 35.66 on bearcat2789's Hog tied and deep fried, and it still wasn't enough, because Bheinzeyo won that game by a single, cruel point. That is the fantasy football equivalent of getting an A on a test and still failing the class. Somewhere bearcat2789 is staring at a stat sheet with Josh Allen's name on it wondering what else he could possibly have done.

Then there's LoRdAcE1848, who got 33.8 out of Jalen Coker and 33.6 out of Jahmyr Gibbs, two absolute studs in the same lineup, and still lost to SexRobot69's Caleb Williams and Derrick Henry death squad. Bibi's Ballers 69 put up 146.86 and it just wasn't enough, which tells you everything about how loaded the winning side was.

Kenneth Walker gave tripnistico 34.1 points, tucked quietly inside a 162.8 explosion for 50 Shades of Zay. No drama there, just a guy doing his job well while everyone else's studs got outdone by somebody else's studs. Welcome to Week 1, where the box scores read like a highlight reel and somebody still has to lose.

articles.headline: Week 1 Power Rankings: One Point Decided Everything Except The Things That Weren't Close At All
articles.deck: Fourteen teams, one bloodbath, one heartbreak by a single point, and one shart so violent it needs its own zip code.
body: Week 1 is done and the league already looks exactly like you'd expect if you've met these idiots before. Somebody scored 169.86 and somebody scored 63.04 in the same week of the same sport, which tells you everything about the gap between preparation and vibes in this league. Here's how everybody stacks up.

1. nunnells (nunnells), Dropped 169.86 on poor Burrowed Alive and walked away with Manager of the Week. This is either a statement or a fluke, and honestly nobody in this league can tell the difference until Week 12.
2. 50 Shades of Zay (tripnistico), 162.8 points behind Kenneth Walker's 34.1, which is a hell of a way to open a season you named after a BDSM joke about a running back.

3. First Down Syndrome (SexRobot69), 156.06 points powered by Caleb Williams throwing for 37.26 and Derrick Henry running for 35.3. Two absurd stat lines in one lineup and the team is still named that.
4. Romo911 (DFWGilly), Put up 153.92 and turned Victorious Secrets into a crime scene, winning by 90.88. Tony would be proud, mostly of the destruction.
5. Jackson Off (Bheinzeyo), Won the closest game in the building, 123.96 to 122.96, a margin of exactly 1. Somewhere bearcat2789 is throwing his remote at a wall right now.
6. Chase Browns with Downs (JPellett3), 118 points, a workmanlike win over ItsYaBoyJack. Nothing sexy, nothing broken, just a W with no adjectives attached.
7. Zyn-bo Squisher (jwslaney), Rolled to 116.22 and buried The Bhayshul Olympics by 40.92. Solid debut for a team named after a nicotine pouch and violence.
8. Bibi's Ballers 69 (LoRdAcE1848), Scored 146.86 with Jalen Coker going for 33.8 and Jahmyr Gibbs going for 33.6 and STILL lost. That's not bad luck, that's a bye week disguised as a roster.
9. BedBathNBIJAN22 (BedBathNBIJAN22), 142.9 points and a loss by 19.9. Solid stat line, wrong week to have it.
10. Hog tied and deep fried (bearcat2789), Josh Allen went off for 35.66 and it still wasn't enough, losing by the margin 1. This is the fantasy equivalent of getting dumped over text.
11. ItsYaBoyJack (ItsYaBoyJack), 95.2 points, lost by 22.8. Forgettable in a league that will not let you forget anything.
12. Burrowed Alive (sebeatty), 77.46 points, lost by 92.4 to nunnells. Buried alive was right there in the name, congrats on the foreshadowing.
13. The Bhayshul Olympics (mattmcneese), 75.3 points, lost by 40.92. The opening ceremony was rough.
14. Victorious Secrets (Tayodin), 63.04 points, the Shart of the Week, beaten by DFWGilly by 90.88. There is nothing victorious about this and the secret is out.

articles.headline: The Trade Desk Is Closed for Business
articles.deck: Week 1 came and went without a single trade getting done, which honestly says more about this league than any blockbuster ever could.
body: Nothing. Zero. Not a single transaction hit the wire this week. Fourteen managers, and not one of you had the stones to pick up the phone.

You'd think somebody watching Victorious Secrets put up 63.04 points would have called Tayodin with an offer, any offer, just to be nice. Nope. Left him twisting in the wind at the bottom of the standings with nobody even pretending to want his players.

Meanwhile nunnells is sitting up top with 169.86 points looking untouchable and not one rival tried to buy a piece of that roster before it gets more expensive. First Down Syndrome just dropped 156.06 and Bibi's Ballers 69 still lost with 146.86 on the board, and somehow neither manager thought a trade might fix what's broken. LoRdAcE1848 watched Jalen Coker go for 33.8 and Jahmyr Gibbs go for 33.6 in the same losing effort and apparently decided that roster is just fine as is.

This is a league full of bubble teams according to the odds, half of you sitting in the 50s and 60s for playoff chances, and the trade market is a ghost town. Get it together by Week 2 or this column is just going to be me screaming into a phone that nobody answers.

articles.headline: Week 2 Preview: Tayodin Gets A Revenge Game Nobody Asked For
articles.deck: The schedule makers took one look at the Shart Bowl loser and immediately fed her to the team that just lost by one measly point. Cruel. Beautiful. Perfect.
body: Let's talk about nunnells first because someone has to acknowledge the murder that happened in Week 1. A 169.86 outing is not a fluke, it's a statement, and now nunnells draws Bibi's Ballers 69, a LoRdAcE1848 squad that put up 146.86 and still lost. That's not a matchup, that's a public execution with a scoreboard attached. If nunnells doesn't roll into 2-0 here I want a full investigation.

Meanwhile tripnistico's 50 Shades of Zay travels to face DFWGilly's Romo911, and this is the closest thing we've got to a real heavyweight fight. Both teams looked scary good in Week 1, both sit up near the top of the power rankings, and somebody's undefeated record is getting torched on national television, or whatever the equivalent is for a league nobody outside this group has ever heard of.

Now for the Shart Bowl. Tayodin's Victorious Secrets put up an embarrassing 63.04 last week, got run over by DFWGilly, and earned the shart with zero complaints from the room. The reward for that performance? A trip to face bearcat2789's Hog tied and deep fried, a team that lost Week 1 by a single point and is absolutely feral for a bounce back. This has next week's low score written all over it in permanent marker, and honestly Tayodin might not even be the worst part of it, bearcat2789's whole roster looked shellshocked after losing by 1.

Elsewhere, JPellett3's Chase Browns with Downs heads to Burrowed Alive to kick sebeatty while he's down, and mattmcneese's Bhayshul Olympics get another crack at relevance against SexRobot69's red hot First Down Syndrome squad. Buckle up, degenerates.
